content.scenario: A consumer, Rohan, files a complaint with the District Commission against a company, XYZ Ltd, for violating his consumer rights by selling a hazardous product. The Central Authority conducts an investigation to determine if there is a prima facie case of violation of consumer rights or unfair trade practices.
content.outcome: The Central Authority may conduct an investigation to determine if there is a prima facie case of violation of consumer rights or unfair trade practices, and may call upon a person referred to in sub-section (1) and also direct him to produce any document or record in his possession.
